transcript: There were a great many things Mara could have said. She knew all of them. She could have said, are you sure? She could have said you needn't. She could have said that the proprietor would take it to the board as evidence for stepping the country, and that the order would take it as evidence for shutting every door but one, and that the mercury would take it as a headline, and that none of them would ask the girl what she meant by it. She could have said that she had sealed that page, so that nobody could ever accuse the girl of borrowing, and not so that a hall full of strangers could read it aloud. She could have said that she was afraid.
